metadata.name: SuperApp Design System - Character Threshold Specification

calculation_method.cjk: available_width_px / font_size_px (1:1 ratio for CJK glyphs)
calculation_method.latin: available_width_px / (font_size_px * 0.55) (average Latin char width = 55% of font size)

metadata.font_family_ios: SF Pro Display (titles/numbers), SF Pro Text (body)

12px.use: Descriptions, input hints, label text, tabs, filter

14px_Regular.use: Long body text, toast, text field hints

14px_Medium.use: Important content labels, long content body title

16px_Medium.use: Body text, important titles, button text

primary_full_width.description: Strong/Primary button, full width in footer or dialog

label.design_system_rule: No wrapping, no truncation, min 1 word, height fixed width variable

primary_split_half.description: Primary button in 1:1 split layout (e.g., Cancel + Confirm)

text_button.description: Text-only button (brand color, danger, hint&link, gray)

label.derivation: Text buttons are inline; practical max width ~200px before looking like paragraph; 200/14=14.3 -> 14 CN; 200/7.7=25.9 -> 25 EN
label.example: View All (7), Cancel (6), Close (5), Add Card (8)

tab_label_4_grid.description: Bottom navigation tab label with 4 tabs

tab_label_3_grid.description: Bottom navigation tab label with 3 tabs

title_with_icons.description: Page title in secondary nav bar with leading and trailing icons

title.derivation: 375 - 16(left margin) - 24(icon) - 12(gap) - 16(title margin) - 16(title margin) - 12(gap) - 24(icon) - 16(right margin) = 243; 243/18=13.5 -> 13 CN; 243/9.9=24.5 -> 24 EN

text_button.derivation: Text button in nav bar ~80px; 80/14=5.7 -> 5 CN; 80/7.7=10.4 -> 10 EN

label.derivation: Max 4 tabs with 24px gaps: practical max per tab ~100px; 100/14=7.1 -> 7 CN; 100/7.7=13 -> 12 EN (conservative)
5 columns: 375/5=75px; 75/12=6.25 -> 6 CN per line; 75/6.6=11.4 -> 11 EN per line; 2 lines allowed

label.description: Input field label above the input

label.example: Debit Account (13), Verification code (17), Phone number (13)

error.derivation: 343/12=28.6 -> 28 CN per line; 343/6.6=52 -> 52 EN per line; 2 lines = 56 CN / 104 EN
error.example: The password is incorrect. Please enter it again. (50 chars)

helper.example: The verification code will expire in 30S (41 chars)

label.derivation: Tag chip max ~120px including 8px padding each side = 104px text; 104/12=8.7 -> 8 CN; 104/6.6=15.8 -> 15 EN (conservative 10/18)

option.derivation: Two-level cascading, each level ~160px; 160/16=10 CN; 160/8.8=18 EN

title.example: Demand Deposit Accounts (22), Total Wealth Assets (18)
Place a Time Deposit: ONLINE REWARD-PLUS TIME DEPOSIT (52)

label.example: Transfer Fee and Intermediary Bank Charges (42 -> 2 lines)

note.derivation: 311/12=25.9 -> 25 CN per line; 311/6.6=47.1 -> 47 EN per line; 3 lines max

label.example: 品牌主色 (4), Success (7), Warning (7), From 1,000.00HKD (16 -> exceeds, use larger tag)

tag_text_wide.description: Wide tag variant for longer text (e.g., financial product tags)

number.derivation: Badge max display: 99+ (3 chars) or 999+ (4 chars); overflow format is fixed

label.derivation: Capsule badge ~40px text area; 40/10=4 CN; 40/5.5=7.3 -> 7 EN

message.derivation: EXPLICIT LIMIT: <=14 CN chars. EN equivalent: 14*14/7.7=25.5 -> 25 EN chars
message.design_system_rule: Plain text toast: max 14 Chinese characters

message.derivation: EXPLICIT LIMIT: 4-6 typical, max 10 CN chars. EN: 10*14/7.7=18.2 -> 18
message.design_system_rule: Image+text toast: 4-6 chars typical, max 10 Chinese characters

message.derivation: Same as success; first char should be '请' (please) in CN
message.example: 请勾选协议 (5), Please check the agreement (26 -> exceeds, trim)

body_text.derivation: 279/14=19.9 -> 19 CN per line; 279/7.7=36.2 -> 36 EN per line; max 5 bullet items

title.derivation: Dialog width ~327px - 2*16 padding = 295; 295/14=21.1 -> 21 CN per line; 295/7.7=38.3 -> 38 EN per line
title.example: 待生效记录已存在 (8), The record pending validation already exists (44 -> 2 lines)

description.derivation: Same as title width; 295/14=21 CN per line; 5 lines = 105 CN / 190 EN total
343/14=24.5 -> 24 CN per line; 343/7.7=44.5 -> 44 EN per line; 3 lines max

label.derivation: 3 buttons in row: 343/3=114.3 - 2*16 padding = 82.3; But split may be uneven. Conservative: 140px per button; 140/16=8.75 -> 8 CN; 140/8.8=15.9 -> 15 EN

text.derivation: Full card width; 311/14=22.2 -> 22 CN per line

description.example: Quick & easy. Arrives in 10s. (29), Track every cent. All transactions, crystal clear. (48)

message.derivation: Full card width; 311/14=22.2 -> 22 CN per line; long-form text, up to 20 lines

command.derivation: EXPLICIT RULE: max 3 commands, no repetition. 311/12=25.9 -> 25 CN per line; 311/6.6=47.1 -> 47 EN per line
command.design_system_rule: Maximum 3 recommended commands, no repetition with previous questions

label.example: View Transaction Details (23 -> exceeds, needs 2 buttons or wider)

message.derivation: EXPLICIT RULE: text word count limited within certain range; countdown max 10s; 311/14=22.2 -> 22 CN per line
message.design_system_rule: Text word count should be limited within a certain character range; countdown animation max 10 seconds
message.example: Waiting for the return result.. (31), Please do not resubmit before the result is returned (52)

label.derivation: Two upload areas side by side: 343/2=171.5 - padding ~160; 160/14=11.4 -> 11 CN; 160/7.7=20.8 -> 20 EN
label.example: ID Card Front Photo (19), ID Card Back Photo (18)

criterion.example: Good (4), No cut (6), Not blurry (10), No glare (8)

text.example: I Agree to the Terms Agreement Name. (35)

label.example: From Account (12), Transfer fees (13), Purpose of Remittance (21 -> exceeds)
